title: TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to a lease with Aerovias Empresa De Cargo SA De CV for cargo facilities…
text:
[Council File 26-1578; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to a lease with Aerovias Empresa De Cargo SA De CV for cargo facilities located at 6851 West Imperial Highway at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' (Board) adoption of staff's determination that the requested action is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article III, Class 1(18)(c) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE the one-year Lease, with a one-year extension option, with Aerovias Empresa De Cargo SA De CV, and associated building rental rate, for premises located at 6851 West Imperial Highway at LAX.
3. CONCUR with the Board's action on August 27, 2026, by Resolution No. 28422, authorizing the Chief Executive Officer, Los Angeles World Airports, or designee, to execute the Lease with Aerovias Empresa De Cargo SA De CV.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board reports that the proposed Lease will generate approximately $3,087,403 in revenue during the initial lease year. Total revenue over the potential two-year term is estimated at approximately $6,422,602, excluding any rental rate adjustments that may occur in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Lease.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 28, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 20, 2026
summary: Council would approve a one-year lease, with a one-year extension option, for Aerovias Empresa De Cargo cargo facilities at 6851 West Imperial Highway at LAX.
